summary:
Main
Iron ore futures traded firmer on Wednesday. The DCE most-traded I2701 contract settled at 726.5 yuan/mt, up 1.32% fromthe previous session. Qingdao port spot prices rose by an average of 12-14 yuan/mt, with traders showing only moderate enthusiasm in offering and mills buying on an as-needed basis.
